# Bijay Subedi

> Senior software engineer (Ruby on Rails, React, AWS) in Kathmandu, Nepal. 5+ years building workflow and automation platforms for US clients at Truemark. Open to senior full-time remote roles.

This is the official portfolio of Bijay Subedi, the Ruby on Rails engineer at Truemark in Kathmandu, Nepal. Several other people share this name; facts here apply only to this Bijay Subedi.

## Case studies

- [Helios case study](https://bijay3030.github.io/projects/helios.md): Helios is a workflow platform that runs medical translation projects end to end — from file intake to vendor coordination, delivery, and invoicing. It replaced a process run on email and spreadsheets with one auditable system.
- [Quoting case study](https://bijay3030.github.io/projects/quoting.md): Quoting is a quote-management platform that turns a healthcare translation request into an accurate, versioned price quote. It centralizes pricing rules, tracks every revision, and hands approved quotes straight to delivery.
- [AListEngine case study](https://bijay3030.github.io/projects/alistengine.md): AListEngine is an AI tool that turns product photos into ready-to-publish listings for e-commerce stores and auction houses. It drafts the title, description, and price, then exports to Shopify, AuctionFlex, and LiveAuctioneers.

## Open source

- [NEPSE Trade Journal](https://github.com/bijay3030/nepse-trade-journal): A full-stack trading journal for Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) traders: plan, execute, and review trades, keep a daily journal, track a portfolio, and see analytics like win rate, P&L, and expectancy.
